title: House to agencies: Ensure P6.2-B El Niño aid reaches farmers, fisherfolk

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives called on government agencies on Wednesday to ensure that P6.2 billion in El Niño assistance reaches affected farmers and fisherfolk as worsening droughts threaten agricultural production.
